answer: Delta-ladder stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits and climbs a ladder in the haven ledger: every rung key-signed and chained to the rung below, one key to one ladder, up a dune. Each rung burns a fee: first 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1). A tundra checkpoint freezes the tip each epoch; auditors replay it against the frozen dune table; a rented rung burns the bond. 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000, lock 70,000, chase 40,000. Honest climbers pay 40.
